title: TransformationResult
description:
The SCTVA agent's transformation and validation result, normalized by the Orchestration Agent (backend/domain/sctva_mapper.py::normalize_execute_result) and returned as `result` from POST /api/workflows/<id>/transform.

SCTVA answers a one-file request with the result fields at the TOP LEVEL and a many-file request with a `file_results` array. Normalization flattens both into `files[]`, so the Transformation and Results stages render one structure either way.

The camelCase summary fields are deliberate: they are the names the DIWO stages already read, kept unchanged when this normalization moved from the browser to the backend.

NOT included: `diff_rows`. Rendering a diff is presentation work, it would roughly double the response size, and the line alignment already runs in the browser. The frontend adds it from before/after with utils/transformationMapper.js::hydrateTransformationResult.

success.description: SCTVA's aggregate verdict. It is false when ANY file was not applied, even if others succeeded — read fileSummary for the breakdown rather than treating false as total failure.

rollbackOccurred.description: SCTVA rolled the change back itself because a safety check failed. Distinct from the DEVELOPER's rollback in the Results stage, which is recorded in the workflow, not here.

confidenceApplicable.description: False when no confidence could be computed; the UI hides the score rather than showing a misleading zero.

refactored_code.description: The `after` text of the first CHANGED file, kept flat because that is the contract the DIWO workflow state expects.

raw.description: SCTVA's untouched response, kept so the stage can show what the agent actually reported next to the normalized view.

file.description: Same value as `path`; both names are read by different stages.

before.description: The ORIGINAL source, taken from the source_files that were sent — not from SCTVA's reply. This is what makes the developer's reject meaningful: rejecting a file writes this text back.

after.description: The refactored source. Empty when nothing was applied.

changed.description: after is non-empty AND differs from before. The stage selects the first changed file to show, because that is what the developer came to see.

validation.description: The four validation stages SCTVA runs. Present per file for a multi-file request and at the top level for a single-file one.
